yontem.ne: Popüler ücretli araçların (Notion, Calendly, Dropbox vb.) ücretsiz ve açık kaynaklı alternatiflerini sunarak maliyet tasarrufu sağlar.
yontem.alinti: Fifteen tools, priced at their top tier, is $747 a month. $569 of that has a free replacement that does the same job.

yazi: Notion -> Obsidian, Calendly -> Cal.com, Dropbox -> Nextcloud, Zapier -> n8n, Miro -> Excalidraw, Figma -> Penpot, Otter.ai -> Granola, Airtable -> Baserow, Loom -> OBS Studio, Typeform -> Google Forms, Mixpanel -> PostHog, DeepL -> LibreTranslate, Intercom -> Chatwoot, Todoist -> Vikunja, 1Password -> Bitwarden
